reason: Two thousand dollars up front plus $249 a month is a lot to put down on something I have never heard talk to my customers. I miss calls, yes, but I call them back when I get a minute and most of them wait.
objection: $1,999.99 before I know if my customers will even talk to a machine. The guarantee only gives the setup back, so I would still have burned two months of $249 and the time to set it up with him.
would_change_my_mind: A setup fee of $500 or less, or no setup and just the monthly, so I can try it for a couple of months and walk away if it does nothing.
